meaning: older male cousin (mother’s side / aunt’s son)
usage: Biu1 go1 refers to an older male cousin from the maternal side, specifically your mother's brother's son or your mother's sister's son.
Use biu1 go1 to clearly specify family relationships, especially when talking about cousins from your mother's side.
When introducing family members, biu1 go1 helps distinguish from paternal cousins or younger cousins.
In casual speech, biu1 go1 can be used alone to indicate the elder male cousin without additional descriptors.
Biu1 go1 is normally followed by verbs or activities, for example, meeting or talking with your biu1 go1.
